h_wording.H413: May cause long lasting harmful effects to aquatic life

presence.note: The UVA filter the maker adds.

why_it_matters.text: A filter for long-wave UVA light. In its enol form it absorbs strongest near 357 nm, and UV light slowly breaks it down, so sunscreens pair it with stabilizers such as octocrylene.

approval.product: OTC Monograph M020, Sunscreen Drug Products for Over-the-Counter Human Use
approval.basis: FDA OTC monograph. M020.10(b), "Avobenzone up to 3 percent", in M020 as amended by Final Administrative Order OTC000039 (issued 2026-06-10, corrected 2026-08-10); the later order OTC000008-1 (Federal Register 2026-09-11) removed only aminobenzoic acid and trolamine salicylate. Checked 2026-11-14.

description: A filter for long-wave UVA light. In its enol form it absorbs strongest near 357 nm, and UV light slowly breaks it down, so sunscreens pair it with stabilizers such as octocrylene.

parts.label: The ketone group
parts.sentence: A C=O with a carbon on each side. Its oxygen accepts hydrogen bonds but has no hydrogen to give, and it resists oxidation better than an aldehyde.

parts.label: The ether oxygen
parts.sentence: An oxygen bridging two carbons, written C-O-C. It accepts hydrogen bonds but has no hydrogen to give, and it is slow to react.

parts.label: The benzene ring
parts.sentence: Six carbons in a flat hexagon, sharing their electrons evenly around the ring. It is stable, flat and oily, and it stacks readily against other flat rings.
